# GlidieBirdie v3.2.0

> Zero-runtime-dependency, no-bundler deterministic 720 Hz fixed-step browser flyer (native ES2022 modules, procedural Web Audio, WCAG 2.2 AA, PWA) with 45 pure Lean 4.35.0 proofs across 6 kernels and an AMS-LaTeX Build White Paper.

- Canonical agent rules: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
- Full LLM bundle: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)
- Claims & falsification ledger: [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md)
- Honest limitations: [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md)
- Replication protocol: [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md)
- Build Standard v1.2.0 manifest: [repo.yaml](repo.yaml)
- Formal Lean 4.35.0 core (45 theorems): [lean/README.md](lean/README.md)
- Build White Paper PDF: [dist/Donahue_2026_glidiebirdie_deterministic_browser_architecture.pdf](dist/Donahue_2026_glidiebirdie_deterministic_browser_architecture.pdf)
- Live browser deployment: https://0thernes.github.io/glidiebirdie/
- Source repository: https://github.com/0thernes/glidiebirdie
